verses.gurmukhi: ਫੁਲਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਇ ਭਵਰੁ ਲੁਭਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: fulaa(n) a(n)dhar vaas hai hoi bhavar lubhaanaa|

en.bdb: The Lord is the fragrance in flowers and becoming black bee He is attracted towards flowers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਸ ਧਰੇ ਕੋਇਲ ਰਸੁ ਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)baa(n) a(n)dhar ras dhare koil ras maanaa|

en.bdb: Sap in the mangoes is He and becoming nightingale He enjoys the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੋਰ ਬਬੀਹਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਘਣ ਵਰਸ ਸਿਞਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: mor babeehaa hoi kai ghan varas sin(j)aanaa|

en.bdb: Becoming peacock and the rain bird (papthd) only He identifies the delight in raining of the clouds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੀਰ ਨੀਰ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਹੋਇ ਕਲੀਕੰਦ ਵਖਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: kheer neer sa(n)jog hoi kaleeka(n)dh vakhaanaa|

en.bdb: He transforms Himself into variegated sweets by becoming milk and water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਿੰਡ ਪਰਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: oa(n)kaar akaar kar hoi pi(n)dd paraanaa|

en.bdb: The same Formless Lord assuming different forms is residing in all the bodies.
He is omnipresent in all substances and activities and gurmukhs bow before all such stages.
